# SaaS Ideas

> A scored, sortable catalog of SaaS product ideas.

## When to use this

- Browsing scored, sortable SaaS product ideas filtered to tech-heavy solo-feasible bets
- Finding SaaS ideas targeting $5K MRR with computed feasibility, customer, fun, and money scores
- Checking the full catalog as JSON for agent consumption
- Getting the product brief as markdown without JavaScript

## Product

- [Catalog](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/): Sort and filter scored SaaS ideas
- [Idea data](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/ideas.json): Generated public catalog data

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract
- [Homepage markdown](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://ideas.sassmaker.com/llms.txt)

## Optional

- [Foundry](https://sassmaker.com): Parent fleet showcase
